_about: Public-domain A. T. Pierson (Arthur Tappan Pierson, 1837-1911, Presbyterian, missions advocate, Spurgeon's successor at the Metropolitan Tabernacle 1891-93) for the Word Hoard: George Müller of Bristol (Project Gutenberg, 1899) and 38 books from Internet Archive scans, 1886-1923, on missions, Bible study, preaching and the Keswick teaching. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
